name: Freya
source:
One of Coffee Talk's most frequent customers. A human woman who works as a journalist by day and an aspiring novelist by night.

Freya has recently earned the chance to write her debut novel but she only has a short time to do so. The drinks you serve her will determine her future.
translation:
One of Coffee Talk's most frequent customers. A human woman who works as a journalist by day and an aspiring novelist by night.
